title: Circuit vent permitted.
officialText:
A maximum of eight fixtures connected to a horizontal branch drain shall be permitted to be circuit
vented. Each fixture drain shall connect horizontally to the horizontal branch being circuit vented. The horizontal branch drain
shall be classified as a vent from the most downstream fixture drain connection to the most upstream fixture drain connection to
the horizontal branch.
